subject: Connector sourcing briefing and P3 partner ask
messages:
From: Sam Reed <sam@pinecone.io>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@redwood-partners.example.com
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: connector sourcing for vector storage

Hi Avery / team,

Thanks for taking a quick look — we had a brief internal sync at Pinecone about your connector requirements sheet and wanted to kick off a lightweight intake. Goal: align on the minimal technical checklist and the preferred commercial path (co-sell vs. marketplace listing vs. integration referral).

Quick context: we're focusing on a hardened connector + cert workflow that covers:
- index lifecycle (create/delete/replicate)
- auth patterns (service tokens, ephemeral creds)
- fallthrough to S3/pgvector for cold tiers
- observability hooks (request-level tracing, error codes)

Would love a 45m intake next week with engineering + partner ops. I attached a short worksheet (connector_requirements_v1.xlsx) showing the things we commonly need.

Proposed times: Tue 3/14 9–10am PT or Wed 3/15 11–11:45am PT.

Cheers,
Sam Reed
Partner Integrations, Pinecone
attachments: connector_requirements_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Sam Reed <sam@pinecone.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: connector sourcing for vector storage

Thanks Sam — appreciate the worksheet, looks helpful.

Team: quick plan from our side so we don't waste the intake slot:
- Ben: draft the SOW template and commercial ask (co-sell vs marketplace)
- Marcus: pull together the tech checklist and a short matrix showing which features require managed index vs local pgvector vs S3 fallthrough
- Vanessa: prepare a short outreach note for our partner-go-to-market team and confirm NDA/Marketplace checklist status

Sam — Tue 3/14 9am PT works for us. I'll send a calendar invite. Please include anyone from Weaviate / pgvector who should attend (technical contact + partner ops).

One request ahead of the call: can you flag any non-standard SLAs or data residency requirements in the worksheet? We'll use that to scope whether this lands as a Dedicated/Private-friendly connector.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Head of Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | avery_johnson@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Intro: connector sourcing for vector storage — Weaviate joining

Hi all — looping in from Weaviate side.

Thanks Sam for the intro. I've attached a short integration brief that outlines our API patterns and recommended durability model (we recommend using vector indexes with external blob storage for large payloads; see weaviate_integration_brief.pdf). We can cover replication and fallback strategies on the intake call.

I confirmed Wed 3/15 11–11:45am PT works for our infra lead, or Tue 9am PT if you prefer an earlier slot.

Some notes ahead of time:
- Auth: OIDC + service account tokens work best for us; we can support signed presigned URLs for S3 blobs.
- Observability: we can emit traces to a vendor of your choice; minimal support for request-level metrics is available out of the box.
- Commercial: Weaviate is open to a certification badge + connector listing in your partner catalog; we will coordinate legal separately.

Attachments: weaviate_integration_brief.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Lina Sørensen
Head of Infrastructure Partnerships, Weaviate

Avery — once the intake call is done we should capture a 1-page SOW stub we can reuse for initial pilots.
